modifications.name: 2'-O-Methyl (2'-OMe)
modifications.description: Universal clinical ribose shield; prevents TLR7/8 recognition and endonucleolytic cleavage (Patisiran, Givlaari, Leqvio, Amvuttra).

modifications.name: 2'-Fluoro (2'-F)
modifications.description: C3'-endo conformation stabilizer; optimizes Ago2 catalytic cleavage efficiency (Givlaari, Oxlumo, Leqvio, Rivfloza).

modifications.name: Phosphorothioate (PS Backbone)
modifications.description: Terminal phosphorothioate internucleotide linkage; defends against 3' and 5' exonucleolytic degradation in serum.

modifications.name: 2'-Deoxyribose (DNA)
modifications.description: Deoxyribonucleotide; standard in 3' overhangs (Patisiran dTdT) and clinical gapmers (Wainua/Eplontersen).

modifications.name: (S)-Glycol Nucleic Acid (GNA)
modifications.description: Acyclic seed-destabilizing monomer (Antisense Pos 7); eliminates microRNA off-target hepatotoxicity (Amvuttra ESC+ standard, FDA 2022).

modifications.name: 5'-Vinylphosphonate (5'-VP) / 5'-P
modifications.description: Metabolically non-hydrolyzable 5'-phosphate mimic; locks antisense 5' end into human Ago2 MID domain (Mivelsiran/ALN-APP standard).

modifications.name: 3'-Terminal Phosphate (3'-P)
modifications.description: Terminal 3' phosphorylation; blocks exonuclease degradation and terminal transferase extension.

modifications.name: 5'-O-Methyl Cap (5'-OMe)
modifications.description: Terminal 5' blocking group on passenger/sense strand; prevents non-specific RISC loading of the sense strand.

modifications.name: 2'-O-Methoxyethyl (2'-MOE)
modifications.description: Bulky nuclease-resistant modification; FDA-approved in Wainua (2023) and Spinraza (2016).

modifications.name: GalNAc Conjugate (Triantennary L96)
modifications.description: High-affinity ASGPR-targeting ligand; enables subcutaneous receptor-mediated hepatocyte uptake (Givlaari, Oxlumo, Leqvio, Amvuttra).

modifications.name: PEG Delivery Conjugate
modifications.description: Polyethylene glycol steric stealth conjugate for prolonged systemic circulation.

modifications.name: Unlocked Nucleic Acid (UNA)
modifications.description: Acyclic C2'-C3' cleaved ribose; thermally destabilizes seed region to mitigate off-target binding (Arcturus platform).

modifications.name: Locked Nucleic Acid (LNA)
modifications.description: Bicyclic 2'-O,4'-C-methylene bridge; extreme C3'-endo affinity clamp and thermal stabilizer (+3-8°C Tm/mod).

modifications.name: Ethylene-bridged Nucleic Acid (ENA)
modifications.description: Conformationally restricted ethylene-bridged nucleic acid with high nuclease stability.

modifications.name: Altritol Nucleic Acid (ANA)
modifications.description: Six-membered altritol ring analogue; modulates helical hydration and target binding.

modifications.name: Threose Nucleic Acid (TNA)
modifications.description: Four-carbon phosphodiester backbone; refractory to natural nucleases with distinct helical pitch.

modifications.name: Abasic Site (1',2'-Dideoxyribose)
modifications.description: Nucleobase-free spacer; eliminates local base-pairing while preserving phosphodiester continuity.

modifications.name: 5-Methylcytosine (5-Me-C)
modifications.description: Methylated cytosine pyrimidine; increases duplex Tm while evading TLR9 activation.

modifications.name: Pseudouridine (Psi)
modifications.description: C-glycosidic isomer of uridine; enhances base stacking and suppresses innate pattern recognition.

modifications.name: 2-Thiouridine (2-thio-U)
modifications.description: Sulfur-modified pyrimidine; stabilizes A-form pairing and confers selective base-pairing kinetics.

modifications.name: Inosine (Hypoxanthine)
modifications.description: Universal wobble nucleobase; pairs promiscuously with C, U, and A with reduced thermal penalty.

modifications.name: Dihydrouridine
modifications.description: Non-aromatic flexible base; destabilizes local stacking for targeted duplex loosening.

modifications.name: 2'-O-Benzyl
modifications.description: Bulky aromatic 2' substituent; sterically obstructs minor groove interactions.

modifications.name: 2'-F-ANA (FANA)
modifications.description: 2'-Deoxy-2'-fluoro-beta-D-arabinonucleic acid; mimics B-form conformation with RNA affinity.

modifications.name: 2'-OMe-4'-thio
modifications.description: Combined 2'-methoxy and 4'-sulfur modification; extreme metabolic and serum stability.

modifications.name: 2'-O-Allyl RNA
modifications.description: Allyl ether substitution for nuclease resistance and hydrophobic groove modulation.

modifications.name: Boranophosphate
modifications.description: Isosteric neutral borane backbone modification; lipophilic and nuclease-resistant.

modifications.name: Methylphosphonate
modifications.description: Non-ionic uncharged methylphosphonate linkage for improved cellular membrane interaction.

modifications.name: Phosphoramidate
modifications.description: Nitrogen-substituted internucleotide linkage; altered charge distribution.

modifications.name: Xanthosine
modifications.description: Purine analogue for selective base pairing studies.
